name: README
title: README
description: Read before interpreting the workbook. Blank cells in vehicle inhibition CI columns mean not applicable, not zero uncertainty.
static_rows: Current-run numerical results and source-data tables for the revised UVSM analysis.
Software 1.2.0; numerical definitions retained from verified R1 analysis 1.0.0.
432 measurement rows, 48 factor combinations, 9 rows per combination. Source-row locators are not recovered biological plate IDs.
44 unique fluorescence pixel exports; A–D have 9 exports each, E–F have 4 each. Duplicate archive copies are not additional observations.
Central (r/rmax ≤ 0.30) and peripheral (r/rmax ≥ 0.80) zones of the sampled colony ROI. Actual growth-front correspondence remains unconfirmed.
All plots retain the supplied row/column coordinates. No circle fitting, warping, boundary tracing, filling, or new pixel extraction is used for display.
Colony-derived pixels are reported by the authors; the precise selection rule and physical pixel scale require acquisition provenance.
Reviewer-requested factorial raw-area model, HC3 covariance, sum-to-zero coding. UV dose is categorical.
8 direct compound-versus-vehicle UV contrasts: Holm correction. Individual HC3 CIs are not simultaneous Holm-adjusted CIs.
Original maximum absolute mean-difference permutation result and studentized max-|t| sensitivity are reported together. The 717.9-nm band was selected on the same dataset.
Pointwise percentile bootstrap intervals are not simultaneous intervals across all bands or across ROI cutoffs.
Historical dose-table means reproduce, but some historical CI limits do not exactly reproduce. R1 follows the reproduced 5000/1337 convention; legacy limits are retained in provenance.
Existing fields do not identify independent runs, medium lots, compound lots, or operators. Analyses do not establish between-run reproducibility.
E/F designations follow the legacy codebook; composition/UV/acquisition metadata need confirmation. No global background-equivalence claim is made.
JMP clustering is a historical published/submitted-table transcription, not a rerun or Python approximation. Python PCA is separately named.
Scientific model/bootstrap outputs are preserved fixed results. Table 1 inhibition and Table 2 mean differences are formulas with checks against frozen exports.
Exact CSV outputs and their hashes accompany this workbook in source_data/ and code/input_manifest.json.
No new wet-lab experiment, no chemical recovery assay, no new isolate validation, no causal substrate/compound attribution, and no GitHub update.

name: Table1_Efficacy
title: Table1 Efficacy
description: Area and inhibition intervals: pointwise percentile bootstrap. Inhibition = 100 × (1 − treatment mean / matched vehicle mean). Vehicle CI cells are blank because reference inhibition is 0 by definition, not a precision estimate.

name: Table2_HSI
